label: D1 after a reward, with a mild a2-leaning policy logit (late in episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded). Almost always the previous choice and the upcoming choice are both a2 (stay). The D1 policy logit choice = logit(a1)-logit(a2) falls in a narrow band of about -3 to -2.2, so it looks like a band-pass on the a2-leaning state. This band captures ~100% of activations and mass, but precision is only ~15%: most rewarded-a2 D1 steps in that band stay silent. Activity rises strongly with episode trial (none before trial 10, peaks at trials 70-79, none at 90-99) and with lower value. It often comes in decaying streaks over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (e.g. 0.85, 0.27, 0.04). Never fires at GO or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or on a1 choices. Uses no future variables: choice is the agent own logit at that step. Magnitude claims beyond the streak decay are unchecked.
